description: This class 'IniFileMetaInfo' provides metadata information for an INI file, including details such as number of pages, signature, page sizes, read commands, and blocking factors. It offers methods to retrieve these properties and is constructed using data from a 'RawIniFile' object.

classes.name: IniFileMetaInfo
classes.description: Java class that encapsulates metadata for an INI file, providing properties and accessors related to file structure and reading parameters.

methods.name: IniFileMetaInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes metadata properties from a RawIniFile instance.

methods.name: getnPages
methods.description: Returns the number of pages in the INI file.

methods.name: getBlockingFactor
methods.description: Returns the blocking factor used for reading chunks.

methods.name: getTotalSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of all pages combined.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature string of the INI file.

methods.name: getPageReadCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the read command associated with a specific page index.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a specific page given its index.
